question: If 1 is added to each odd digit and 2 is subtracted from each even digit in the number 8147563, what will be the sum of the digits that are second from the left and second from the right?
solution:
Given number 8147563

 1 is added to each odd digit and 2 is subtracted from each even digit

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ab417c3d743fc62e1ee8e6b376cdd4554476e4dc1600bd6e0b089ffeac5d1478.png] 

The sum of the digits that are second from the left and second from the right = 4 + 2 = 6.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4"**
